acceptance: A drafts-only or links-only break is caught before merge
The check covers queue-to-file set equality, not just link resolution
context: The 26-to-26 queue/filesystem equality and 78-link integrity were verified with one-off throwaway scripts during PR #46 review (Gemini) and implementation verification; nothing in CI re-runs them. Raised as L2 blind spots by both follow-up reviewers.
description: Add a CI check that fails when a drafts article lacks a queue row (or vice versa), when a queue/plan relative link breaks, and when a blog post misses its index toctree entry. Today all three drift silently.
